task.title: QA: read-only electron-builder tool-cache check (H3c) in verify:packaging-host
task.objective: Owner prompt 2026-11-08 'Resolve electron-builder Tool Dependencies and Resume N7 Packaging' section 5: before repeating the full packaging pipeline, verify that the three electron-builder 25.1.8 build tools (winCodeSign 2.6.0, nsis 3.0.4.1, nsis-resources 3.4.1) are locally resolvable. Extend the existing read-only verify:packaging-host with H3c: read each tool's version and SHA-512 from the installed toolchain (app-builder-lib JS, app-builder.exe), hash candidate .7z archives from an operator-supplied --tool-archives folder, and compare the extracted app-builder cache folder against a verified archive (per-file size and CRC32 from the bundled 7za listing). Statuses: PRESENT AND VERIFIED, MISSING, CHECKSUM MISMATCH, VERSION MISMATCH, INVALID CACHE LAYOUT, INCONCLUSIVE. It acquires, copies, extracts and changes nothing; no new npm script, no dependency, version, checksum or packaging change.

acceptance.description: verify:packaging-host reports each electron-builder tool archive and cache folder with one of the six statuses, never claims verification without hashing or comparing, changes nothing on disk, and npm run build passes.

evidence.observed: 2026-11-08 on the ARM64 host: READY. H3c recognized all three pins in the installed toolchain (winCodeSign 2.6.0 SHA-512 embedded in app-builder-bin 5.0.0-alpha.10 app-builder.exe; nsis 3.0.4.1 and nsis-resources 3.4.1 from app-builder-lib 25.1.8 JS) and reported each as MISSING in C:\Users\mohammadabwini\AppData\Local\electron-builder\Cache (INFO, networked hosts fetch and verify it). The guard admits npm run verify:* only without arguments, so archives are read from the default %LOCALAPPDATA%\SpecterStudio\release-inputs\electron-builder-tools staging folder; --tool-archives and --builder-cache serve owner runs.

history.released_reason: verify:packaging-host H3c read-only electron-builder tool-cache check implemented and run READY
